messages.screen.library.value.skimmerManeuver: Additional skimmer move after the Fire Phase
messages.library.rules.movement.title: Movement and terrain
messages.library.rules.movement.body: MP means movement points. Each hex entered costs points. The movement preview shows the total cost for this unit and route.
messages.library.rules.fire.title: Sight, cover and hit chance
messages.library.rules.fire.body: Check range, line of sight and cover in the target menu. Hit means hit chance. What counts as a hit depends on the target. Check the destruction chance when shown.
messages.library.rules.gev.title: Extra skimmer move
messages.library.rules.gev.body: Eligible skimmers get a separate movement budget after the fire phase. Pick a reachable fallback hex before attacking.
messages.library.rules.systems.title: Weapons, components and treads
messages.library.rules.systems.body: Choose an available weapon slot. Against a system target, choose a component or the treads. Tread losses can reduce movement. Each missile slot fires once per mission. AP weapons only affect infantry.
messages.library.rules.ram.title: Ramming
messages.library.rules.ram.body: The Mk III and Mk V can ram eligible conventional vehicles. Check the command preview before committing.
messages.library.rules.strength.title: Infantry strength
messages.library.rules.strength.body: For the Infantry Squad and Amphibious Infantry, current squad strength determines attack and defense. D removes one squad, and X destroys the unit.
messages.library.rules.siege.title: Main fire and AP
messages.library.rules.siege.body: Split main fire between different targets or combine both slots into one attack. NE still spends the slot used. Separate AP weapons only affect infantry.
messages.library.rules.spotter.title: Direct and indirect fire
messages.library.rules.spotter.body: Direct fire requires the gun’s own line of sight. For indirect fire, select an active allied spotter with direct sight of the enemy target. The spotter must be outside a transport.
messages.library.rules.passengers.title: Transporting infantry
messages.library.rules.passengers.body: Load infantry from an adjacent hex during the movement phase. Capacity used depends on current strength or hit points. Infantry can fire aboard. After unloading onto a free, passable adjacent hex, it cannot move farther or board again that turn.
messages.library.rules.drones.title: Loading and deploying drones
messages.library.rules.drones.body: Loading or deploying a drone spends its movement and fire and the carrier’s primary move. Deploy it onto a free, passable adjacent hex outside water or river terrain. It can fire from the next friendly turn. A drone aboard cannot fire or spot.
messages.library.rules.engineering.title: Engineering actions
messages.library.rules.engineering.body: An engineering action spends the unit’s movement and fire during the movement phase. Depending on the target, you can clear terrain, build a field position or bridge, repair an ally or salvage a wreck. Check materials and target in the preview.
messages.library.rules.missile.title: Missile aimed at a hex
messages.library.rules.missile.body: Choose a hex within range and in the launcher’s line of sight. The blast covers the target and neighboring hexes, including friendly units. A confirmed launch spends the ammunition even if the target hex is empty.
messages.library.rules.stealth.title: Stealth and detection
messages.library.rules.stealth.body: Movement alone does not break stealth. Nearby active enemies with direct sight can detect the platform. Firing, receiving an attack even with no effect, and collisions reveal it. An event reveal lasts until the end of the observing team’s next fire phase.
messages.library.rules.raider.title: Raider Skimmer movement
messages.library.rules.raider.body: The Raider Skimmer uses skimmer terrain costs and moves only before the fire phase.
messages.library.rules.infantryFixed.title: Infantry with fixed stats
messages.library.rules.infantryFixed.body: For Field Engineers, Local Defense and Infantry Platoon, D removes one hit point. Attack and defense stay the same. X destroys the unit.
messages.library.unit.goblin-siegebreaker.tactics: Save missiles for targets beyond your batteries’ reach. In a duel, consider taking out the most dangerous weapons first.
messages.library.unit.skimmer-scout.tactics: Use the scout’s reach to fire from a distance. Fall back behind a sight blocker afterward if needed.
messages.library.unit.rocket-artillery.tactics: Keep your distance and look for a clear line of sight. Rocket Artillery fires directly, so choose a position with a clear firing lane.
messages.library.unit.infantry-squad.tactics: Advance through cover and fire at close range. Losing a squad weakens both attack and defense.
messages.library.unit.assault-tank.tactics: Use its movement to close to short range. Check your hit chance from cover before advancing farther.
messages.library.unit.recon-tank.tactics: Go around sight blockers to find a clear line of sight. Stay in cover if the enemy can return fire.
messages.library.unit.siege-tank.tactics: Combine main fire against a tough target. Separate shots may be better when you have two suitable targets.
messages.library.unit.long-range-battery.tactics: The battery stays on its starting hex. Position a spotter who can see targets beyond obstacles for indirect fire.
messages.library.unit.mobile-siege-gun.tactics: Use its short move to open a firing lane. If the target remains obscured, check for indirect fire with a spotter.
messages.library.unit.combat-skimmer.tactics: Attack from an angle with a clear view. Use the extra skimmer move afterward to break the enemy’s line of sight.
messages.library.unit.light-skimmer.tactics: Choose a route with a safe retreat and avoid heavy enemies. Use its mobility to attack less protected targets.
messages.library.unit.skimmer-carrier.tactics: Plan the drop-off before approaching. A drone takes the whole cargo space. After loading infantry, the carrier can still move.
messages.library.unit.strategic-missile-carrier.t: Look for a target hex with other enemies on adjacent hexes. Check the friendly-fire warning and save your launch for a good opportunity.
messages.library.unit.artillery-drone.tactics: Deploy on a hex with a clear view of likely targets. The drone can relocate only by transport and fires directly.
messages.library.unit.amphibious-infantry.tactics: Use water and rivers as an alternate route. Aim to finish in cover before attacking at close range.
messages.library.unit.field-engineers.tactics: Plan engineering work before advancing. Clear a route for allies or repair an adjacent vehicle when it is worth giving up the shot.
messages.library.unit.local-defense.tactics: Hold a covered choke point. The short range suits close defense better than chasing mobile targets.
messages.library.unit.forge-engineer.tactics: Protect the tools and drone bays. Engineering requires an intact tool, and losing an occupied bay destroys the drone inside.
messages.library.unit.command-hub.tactics: The Command Hub stays in place and does not fire. Defend its approaches or, when attacking, check when you have a worthwhile shot.
messages.library.unit.goblin-dreadnaught.tactics: Use its broad arsenal to choose weapons for each range. In a duel, tread hits can slow the opponent.
messages.library.unit.phantom-platform.tactics: Approach on a route that keeps you away from enemy observers. Time your first shot carefully because it reveals you.
messages.library.unit.infantry-platoon.tactics: Use cover to hold an approach. Losing a hit point leaves attack and defense unchanged as long as the unit survives.
messages.library.unit.command-core.tactics: The Command Core stays in place and does not fire. Check the mission objective and plan a clear firing lane if you need to destroy it.
messages.library.unit.relay-node.tactics: The Relay Node stays in place and does not fire. Check the mission objective before committing an attack to it.
messages.library.unit.guard-tank.tactics: Pick a covered hex early with sight of the likely approach. The Guard Tank’s short move makes repositioning slow.
messages.library.unit.raider-skimmer.tactics: Use passable waterways to approach from another direction. Pick your final hex before firing because the Raider Skimmer has no extra skimmer move.
